definition: a large building for storing goods
description: A tall storage warehouse with long aisles and racking stacked to the roof with wrapped pallets. In the foreground a chihuahua wearing a yellow hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest stands on its hind legs looking off to the side. Behind it a golden retriever drives an orange forklift carrying pallets of bottled water, while another small dog in a hi-vis vest walks down the aisle. The forklift catches the stack and the pallets of water burst apart, spilling packs of bottles all over the concrete floor. The chihuahua turns to the camera with wide eyes.
transcript: Okay, now back up slowly. Tranquilo, despacio. I don't know what you're saying. Speak English. Dios mio! I'm clocking out.

taps.target: the small dog at the back
